name: zt_flow_evidence
title: Zero trust flow evidence
description: Hubble flow evidence for one source workload: verdict counts (FORWARDED, AUDIT, DROPPED) by direction, source and destination identities and labels, pods, the node that observed each flow, the policies that allowed or denied it, the drop reason, first and last seen, and the destination store's allowlist and mode. Call it after zt_finding_context. workload is namespace/name, for example build-farm/ci-runner; dest is namespace/name such as ai-train/checkpoint-store, or * for every destination.

workload.description: Source workload as namespace/name, for example build-farm/ci-runner

dest.description: Destination workload as namespace/name, or * for any

execution.template: | savedsearch "ZT Agent - Flow Evidence" workload=$workload$ dest=$dest$
